name: PaginationItems
description: Generates a page button for each visible page and an ellipsis for each skipped range, based on `totalPages`, `siblingCount`, and `boundaryCount` of the root. Place it between `Pagination.Previous` and `Pagination.Next`. Doesn't render its own HTML element.

props.name: children
props.description: Content shown in place of the generated page buttons. As a function, receives the pages to show, each with a `type` (`NUM` for a page, `BREAK` for an ellipsis) and a page number in `value`.
